text: {"lessons":["I added to Stock C three times as its purchase price rose from 76.28 to 83.89; next time I’ll check whether an added position still fits my plan rather than buying simply because I’ve already bought it.","My account was still below its Period 1 value by Period 10 despite a strong Period 6; I’ll judge progress over a longer horizon and track contributions separately from investment performance.","I only bought and never sold during these periods, so I’ll set in advance what would justify trimming or exiting a holding, while respecting my no-borrowing and no-short-selling limits."]}
